quiet_nudge.title: Vinnie
quiet_nudge.body: You've been quiet. Too quiet. In my experience, that's never good. What'd you buy?

quiet_nudge.title: Vinnie
quiet_nudge.body: Two days, no receipts. Either you're a saint or you're hiding something. I've met zero saints.

quiet_nudge.title: Vinnie
quiet_nudge.body: Luc thinks you forgot about us. I told him you'd never. Capiche?

late_month.title: Vinnie
late_month.body: We got {daysLeft} days and {remaining}. Walk with me.

late_month.title: Vinnie
late_month.body: {daysLeft} days left, {remaining} in the budget. Piano, piano, kid.

sitdown.title: Vinnie wants a word
sitdown.body: Sit down. We need to talk. It's nothin' bad. Probably.

sitdown.title: The weekly sit-down
sitdown.body: Espresso's on. Bring your receipts. Come alone. Kidding. Five minutes.

proactive_call.title: 📞 Vinnie is calling…
proactive_call.body: Pick up. It's me. Just checking in.

proactive_call.title: 📞 Vinnie is calling…
proactive_call.body: You gonna answer or what? Mamma mia.
